world_org_meetings.title: Watch: Threats, deals and passionate speeches at UNGA event
world_org_meetings.description: Delegations from across the world attended the United Nations General Assembly in New York.

world_org_meetings.title: The United Nations General Assembly is meeting. Is it accomplishing anything?
world_org_meetings.description: NPR's Mary Louise Kelly speaks with Michael Froman, Council on Foreign Relations president, at the UN General Assembly.

world_org_meetings.title: Zelenskyy to address UN, Rubio to meet Russian counterpart — but few breakthroughs expected
world_org_meetings.description: Russia pounded Kyiv with drone strikes on Wednesday, hitting railway infrastructure, warehouses and fuel stations, just hours before Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy addresses the United Nations General Assembly in New York.

world_org_meetings.title: UN General Assembly enters second day with key speeches ahead
world_org_meetings.description: It’s Day Two of the United Nations General Assembly in New York, with a packed programme including speeches by Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian and Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky. Some of the biggest names in artificial intelligence will also address the UN Security Council. France 24’s Jessica Le Masurier is covering the gathering for us.

world_org_meetings.title: World leaders weigh AI worries, regulations
world_org_meetings.description: AI leaders are due to brief the UN Security Council at an emergency session later today. The meeting comes after weeks of warnings about the potentially uncontrollable risks posed by artificial intelligence. Delano D’Souza reports.

diplomatic_visits.title: U.S. ambassador to the U.N. discusses progress on key issues
diplomatic_visits.description: NPR's Steve Inskeep speaks with U.S. Ambassador to the U.N. Mike Waltz about President Trump's visit to the U.N. General Assembly and whether progress has been made on key issues.

diplomatic_visits.title: Modi to visit Canada as Carney looks to finalize trade deal with India by end of year
diplomatic_visits.description: Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi is expected to visit Canada in December, Prime Minister Mark Carney confirmed on Tuesday, as the two countries look to reach a trade deal by the end of the year — further signs that the once deep diplomatic chasm between the two governments is being bridged.

diplomatic_visits.title: 'What he's doing is positively un-American': Late-night hosts react to Trump media ban
diplomatic_visits.description: The comedians of late-night television have a vested interest in protecting the First Amendment. So when U.S. President Donald Trump announced he was banning news outlets CNN, MS NOW, and Politico from the White House last Friday, they came out swinging.

diplomatic_visits.title: Taiwan watching closely as Xi and Trump meet and hopes US will keep up its arms sales
diplomatic_visits.description: Taiwan is expressing confidence that U.S. arms sales to the island will continue despite China's pressure as China’s Xi Jinping arrives in Washington to meet with U.S. President Donald Trump

diplomatic_visits.title: Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian arrives in New York for UNGA
diplomatic_visits.description: Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian has arrived in New York as the US-Iran war continues.

elections.title: South Sudan's president dissolves government ahead of country's first elections
elections.description: South Sudan has not held elections since independence in 2011 - polls have twice been postponed.

elections.title: Dems have an edge over GOP, poll finds. And, ICE looks into 'mobile detention centers'
elections.description: An NPR poll shows that Democrats have an edge over Republicans going into the midterms, partially due to Trump. And, Immigration and Customs Enforcement is looking into "mobile detention centers."

elections.title: International watchdog calls for protection of journalists ahead of Serbia election
elections.description: An international media watchdog says that journalists in Serbia are increasingly under threat of violence and hostility ahead of a high-stakes early parliamentary election that will test populist President Aleksandar Vucic’s rule

elections.title: How US players are reshaping France and the continent
elections.description: In this edition we welcome CNN's correspondent in France, Melissa Bell. Melissa is the author of "Sous l'influence americaine", an investigation into American interference in France and Europe. She tells us about the ways in which American interference is being felt in Europe and France and what we should expect during the 2027 French presidential election campaign.

elections.title: Morocco votes for new parliament amid hopes and concerns over cost of living
elections.description: Hopes and concerns over jobs, wages, public services and cost of living dominate Morocco’s parliamentary election as the country prepares for the 2030 World Cup.
